column1: # Physical AT scancode -> hwdb key name for the HP Pro c640 top row.
# Inferred on real Dratini hardware on 2026-10-31: EVIOCGKEY showed the
# post-hwdb key state (KEY_F1..F10) and, combined with the standard AT
# scancode->keycode table, this corresponds to scancodes 0x3b-0x44 (keycodes
# 59-68); EVIOCGKEYCODE was then used to verify the kernel's translation.
# NOTE: EVIOCGKEY reports post-hwdb keycodes, not raw MSC_SCAN, so it alone
# does not *prove* the raw scancode. To verify MSC_SCAN directly use plain
# `evtest` (do NOT pass --grab) or this repo's `--scan` mode after stopping
# keyd (`sudo systemctl stop keyd`); when done run `sudo systemctl start keyd`
